component.name: Window Zones
Organização de janelas
component.summary: Snap windows to zones and tile them, the Window Maker way
Encaixe janelas em zonas e organize em mosaico, do jeito do Window Maker

description.p: Window Zones (wmake-zones) adds snap zones and automatic tiling to the Big WindowMaker desktop, on X11 with Window Maker and on Wayland with wlmaker, while Window Maker stays a floating window manager until you turn them on.
O wmake-zones acrescenta zonas de encaixe e mosaico automático ao Big WindowMaker, no X11 com o Window Maker e no Wayland com o wlmaker; o Window Maker continua flutuante até você ligar.

ul.li: Zones while dragging: drop a window on a zone, or between two to use both; Esc cancels
Zonas ao arrastar: solte numa zona, ou entre duas para usar as duas; Esc cancela
Fifteen layouts (halves, thirds, quarters, grids, ultrawide, portrait) and a visual editor for your own
Quinze layouts (metades, terços, quartos, grades, ultrawide, retrato) e um editor visual para os seus
Auto Tiling with master and stack, columns, rows, grid, BSP, monocle, spiral and dwindle
Mosaico automático com principal e pilha, colunas, linhas, grade, BSP, monocle, espiral e dwindle
Per monitor and per workspace layouts, per application rules and keyboard shortcuts
Layouts por monitor e por área de trabalho, regras por aplicativo e atalhos de teclado
A dock app for the Dock or Clip and the NeXTSTEP look of the Window Maker theme, light or dark
Um dockapp para o Dock ou o Clip e o visual NeXTSTEP do tema do Window Maker, claro ou escuro
No CPU while idle and well under 3 MiB of memory
Nenhuma CPU em repouso e bem menos de 3 MiB de memória

description.p: The Wayland dock app can be dragged to the Dock and the Clip again, by its tile border.
Tiling that copes with GTK4 windows, a draggable LCD-style dock app, and the Wayland dock app the size of its tile.

ul.li: GTK4 windows that do not fit a cell swap places or float, with the reason shown
The X11 dock app can be dragged to the Dock and the Clip and opens Window Maker's menu
Dock app in an LCD style, with a transparent icon and clearer controls
The Wayland dock app draws the whole tile at the configured size
Brazilian Portuguese translation reviewed; About lists the maintainers and credits

description.p: Reliable tiling on several monitors and a dock app that shows the mode.
Zones on by default, layout first and then the zone, Wayland on par with X11, and a dock app that switches Zones and Tiling in one click.
Equal zones with gaps, sturdier service and editor, left-handed mice, and a manual page.

ul.li: Zones of the same weight now have the same size when there is a gap
Drags work with swapped mouse buttons and never get stuck
The service and the preferences no longer overwrite each other's settings; symbolic links are kept
Programs opened by the service can be closed normally
Keyboard layout changes update the shortcuts
New commands: help and windows -l

description.p: First release: zones, automatic tiling, zone editor, preferences and dock apps for X11 and Wayland.
